result.title: LatticeRank: Spacing-Ranked Consistency for Native-Grid 3D Medical Image Segmentation
result.summary: Variable voxel spacing changes more than image resolution: it alters the discrete sampling lattice, tensor geometry, and anatomical evidence available to a 3D segmentation network. While conventional pipelines restore images to a canonical grid, direct-grid deployment requires the model itself to tolerate these changes. We observe that candidate grids are not exchangeable views -- a coarse grid removes more structural information than a mildly resampled one -- yet standard consistency objectives assign them equal influence. We therefore propose LatticeRank, a training-only framework that aligns candidate posteriors in physical space and allocates consistency supervision by voxel-spacing order: among endpoint-matched candidates, the auxiliary loss concentrates on the coarsest requested grid, while inference retains a single network forward with no candidate branch or ensemble. On MSD Task04, LatticeRank improves coarse-grid Extra Dice over mean consistency by 0.03436 across five seeds while meeting the prespecified reference-grid noninferiority criterion. A controlled ladder shows that grid exposure provides the largest recovery, posterior consistency adds a second gain, and spacing-ranked allocation yields the strongest direct-grid result; requested spacing thus provides a simple, model-independent ordering signal for direct-grid consistency learning.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 LatticeRank，一个仅在训练期使用的框架：在物理空间对齐候选网格的后验，并按体素间距顺序把一致性监督集中到最粗网格，推理仍只需单次前向。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「候选并非等价视图、按信息损失排序分配辅助监督」的思路，或可供核查 LVR 训练中视觉证据与辅助监督如何按信息量加权的问题；但任务为 3D 医学分割，与 latent 推理状态生成无直接联系。
